brief.topic: Repentance and returning to Allah after a mistake
brief.audience: Muslims who want a short, trustworthy daily reminder they can act on

coreInsight: Qur'an 39:53 tells those who have wronged themselves not to despair of Allah's mercy, so a mistake can be the start of a return.

hooks.text: A mistake doesn't have to be the end
hooks.notes: Clear in two seconds; the teaching answers it.

hooks.text: Is it too late to come back?

selectionRationale: Most relevant and clearest at a glance; the teaching pays it off.

scenes.onScreen: A mistake is not the end of your return. / Read this if you feel too far.
scenes.sub: Read this if you feel too far.

scenes.purpose: Teaching: the source, verbatim, with its reference.

resolved.arabic: ۞قُلۡ يَٰعِبَادِيَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَسۡرَفُواْ عَلَىٰٓ أَنفُسِهِمۡ لَا تَقۡنَطُواْ مِن رَّحۡمَةِ ٱللَّهِۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَغۡفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ جَمِيعًاۚ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلۡغَفُورُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ ٥٣
resolved.english: Say, "O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of Allah. Indeed, Allah forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful
resolved.transliteration: Qul ya AAibadiya allatheena asrafoo AAala anfusihim la taqnatoo min rahmati Allahi inna Allaha yaghfiru alththunooba jameeAAan innahu huwa alghafooru alrraheemu

scenes.onScreen: REFLECTION / Come back, as you are. / Feeling far is not a reason to stay away. The door this ayah describes is open to the one who returns. Begin with a sincere istighfar today.
